name: B10-0332/2025 (S&D) – Tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on China's restrictions on exports of rare earth materials, which are vital for cars, renewable energy and defence. It criticises the restrictions, calls on China to lift them, and asks the European Commission and member states to raise the issue at the European Union–China summit on 24–25 July 2025. It also calls for a strategy to depend less on China.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; this is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests.
- **Who it affects:** European industries using rare earths, and the Commission and member states in talks with China.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states are urged to raise it at the 24–25 July 2025 summit.
